name: album-art
title: Album Artwork
summary: Thumbnails next to the albums and the playlists.
description: Shows the album cover at the left of each album and each playlist in the lists of the iPod.
details: Each album in a list shows a small picture of its cover. The patch makes the picture from the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod.
Each playlist shows a custom image, or the covers of its first four albums.
requires: Albums: the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod. No other file is necessary.
Playlists: a thumbnail file on the iPod. Use the Thumbnails section below to write it after you flash the firmware.
notes: The patch reads iPod_Control/Artwork/ArtworkDB and the 100 × 100 images in F1028_N.ithmb.
iPodFirm writes the playlist thumbnails to the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmAlbumArt on the iPod.
While the wheel moves, a row whose cover is not in memory shows a grey square. The cover shows when the wheel stops.
With "iPod Artwork", the patch loads the covers in the background while an album list shows and the wheel does not move.
Version 2.5 is a measurement build. It writes the times of its parts to the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmAlbumArtStats. The write can stop the scroll for a short time.

choices.title: iPod Artwork
choices.description: The patch makes each thumbnail from the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod. No other step is necessary. The first scroll is slower, because the patch reads each new album cover from the disk.

choices.title: iPodFirm Thumbnail File (faster)
choices.description: The patch uses the thumbnails in the file that iPodFirm writes. The file stays in memory, thus the scroll reads nothing from the disk. An album that is not in the file uses the iPod artwork.
choices.caution: After each sync that adds or changes albums, click "Write Thumbnails to iPod" in the Thumbnails section. Then disconnect the iPod.
